svg.title: IS-14: a person steps under the lowering lift carriage, looping
svg.desc: Looping top view of IS-14: a person steps under the lowering lift carriage. A fixed crop of the warehouse plan with the robot, its field where one applies, the person on their path at walking speed, the events lighting up below, a cursor on a time strip and a plot of the distance between the person and the robot, which reaches 0.02 m in the planning case.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
